# langsmith_tool (Data Source)

Looks up a LangSmith platform tool by `handle` or by `id`. Exactly one of the two must be set — a handle is the readable name a tool is published under, while the ID addresses it even after a rename.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_tool" "lookup_customer" {
  handle = "lookup-customer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `handle` (String) Handle of the tool to look up. Conflicts with `id`.
- `id` (String) UUID of the tool to look up. Conflicts with `handle`.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `metadata` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `parameters` (String)
- `returns` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
